notes.title: Small QOL update
notes.notes:
This is a minor update to make the beginning of the game a bit more friendly to newcomers, as well as introducing some QOL changes.

What has changed:
[list]
[*]Sword starting speed has been increased while slightly lowering the amount of speed obtained from leveling up agility.

[*]Sword starting durability has been increased while slightly lowering the amount gained from leveling up strength.

[*]The amount of insanity required for the Old Man to come to life has been lowered.

[*]You can now view the controls by pressing backspace on keyboard or select on controller.

[*]A message now appears when the player dies with the Immortality blessing to indicate that they did not lose a life.

[/list]
Feel free to suggest anything else, and I will be happy to try to make this game the best that it can be.
